A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (the type bar, the stat boxes and the deploy and forfeit numbers) with its corrected game text, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 March 2017 (the PDF was made on 31 May 2017).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-L-red3-PC-Errata-2017-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Red 3]]: The game text changes: “Must have pilot aboard to use power, maneuver or hyperspeed.”, which [[Red 3 (Unlimited)|Premiere Unlimited]] added to the printed text, is removed. The slip adds the [[Nav Computer]] icon at the right of the game-text box. The slip shows only the lower part of the card and adds a white italic “E” at the lower right.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2017 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
